title: Can Multimodal LLMs solve complex tasks?
reading: The slide poses whether multimodal LLMs can handle complex, compound tasks, illustrated with a single example prompt: building a database that links runner faces to their bib numbers. A race photograph accompanies the prompt as the input the model would have to parse, implying the task requires face detection, text/OCR reading of bibs, and association between the two.

visuals.description: Photograph of a crowded road race: many runners in colorful gear on wet pavement, each wearing a numbered bib.
visuals.assertion: A realistic input image where multiple faces and bib numbers must be detected and correctly paired.
